decisions.notes: The CNEP locator writes this branch "AIN –AZEL": the commune name with a stray dash wedged into it, not a separator between two halves of a name. Folding the dash to " - " would publish "AIN - AZEL", which reads as a branch called Azel in a place called Ain, so the name is corrected to the commune instead. "AIN AZEL" is the spelling this dataset already carries: the flagship commune table reads Ain Azel, and the BADR branch in the same commune publishes AIN AZEL, in the all-caps CNEP writes 212 of its 230 branch names in.
